<div class="article-top"><a class="back-link" href="../writing.html">← Writing</a><p class="eyebrow">Working paper / Project note</p><h1>Love and the Absent Other</h1><p class="page-deck">An exploratory comparative essay</p></div>

::: {.article-copy}

This essay develops questions about relationships with absent, imagined, sacred, fictional, and artificial others. It asks how different settings authorize, privatize, commercialize, or problematize forms of attachment.

The comparison is exploratory. Similarities between cases are prompts for inquiry, rather than evidence of a single historical lineage.

:::
